item.title: Cardano and Injective Launch First Live IBC Testnet Link
item.summary: Cardano and Injective have activated their first live on-chain connection using the Inter-Blockchain Communication protocol, or IBC, on their respective test networks. The development enables the transfer of ADA and INJ tokens between Cardano Preprod and Injective Testnet and marks a significant expansion of interoperability between the two blockchain ecosystems.
